decisions.reason: Camp starter hunt: 170 XP, plainstriders by the well, and it opens the class notes and 750.
Tauren-only: 450 XP, prairie wolf paws north of Bloodhoof (lvl 5-6). Opens 754.
Cougar pelts south of camp (lvl 3): 250 XP, and it unlocks the Battleboars.
Breadcrumb from Chief Hawkwind to the pitcher errand (753): 85 XP, no mobs.
Water pitcher from the camp well: 250 XP, and it opens Rites of the Earthmother.
